entities.summary: The Pleven Regional Historical Museum, founded in 1953, is one of the largest museums in Bulgaria. The museum is situated in a two-story edifice near the centre of Pleven that is a monument of culture of national importance and has an area of 7,000 m2. Its main stock includes over 180,000 units and the museum library houses over 10,000 volumes of scientific literature and periodicals.
